boundary: Public enterprise solution-search states screened for whether the publication channel itself owns matching or resolution.

QIANHAI-SCENE-20260413.claim: Qianhai's 2026 application-scenario meeting publicly presented Tencent headquarters smart-space/industrial-community/life-support/robotics needs and Qianhai Yueshi smart cold-chain needs, while the event and innovation center explicitly provide demand release, interpretation and supply-demand matching.

LONGGANG-CGN-20260602.claim: CGN Intelligent Technology (Shenzhen) publicly asked for stronger surrounding public and commercial service support during a Longgang government visit; departments responded on site, established a long-term coordination mechanism and committed to follow the resolution.

HUANGPU-SCENE-20260731.claim: Huangpu published a 2026 AI-for-industrialization scenario list with named opening units such as Guangzhou Kaicheng Technology and directed responsible departments to support technology innovation, supply-demand matching and project implementation.

BEIJING-SCENES-20260912.claim: Beijing released three application-scenario lists: 40 demand items, 160 capability items and 40 demonstration items; the stated purpose is to match real problems with technologies/solutions and create a supply-demand loop.

DALIAN-DEMAND-20260401.claim: Dalian High-tech Zone solicits enterprise technical and R&D cooperation demand, asks what firms want to connect with, and says it will build demand lists and organize recurring matching activities.

conclusion: Scan162 closes five public-solution-search patterns because the publication/scene channel or government mechanism already owns matching/resolution, or the notice does not expose a named A-side. Next scan moves to independent first-party enterprise disclosures.
